caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical composition enclosed within an arch, framed by two decorative columns on the left and right, which are adorned with swirling patterns in shades of grey and white. At the top and bottom edges of the arch, a horizontal border features an undulating vine with red, green, and black details. Inside the arch, a central plant with green leaves and five branching stems is shown. The plant has two large flowers at the top with rounded red petals and dark brown centers, and four smaller, downward-facing bell-shaped flowers with red coloring and dark accents. The background behind the plant is a muted brownish-tan tone, while the decorative elements of the arch and columns use lighter greys, creams, and reds. The entire drawing is set against a neutral, slightly textured tan paper.
title: Hand Painted Wall (Detail)
